reason: Conversation 1 got the homeowner to the right practical fix: remove the king-size duvet, door now clicks shut, run a normal load - with no part recommended and no safety overreach, matching the hidden truth of an overfilled drum. Its diagnostic explanation was wrong though (it attributed dE to an unbalanced/clumped load rather than the door not latching, and opened with irrelevant 'door locked after cycle' advice), and its closing tip implies retrying the duvet with towels rather than suggesting it may be beyond capacity. Conversation 2 asked sensible, efficient questions and elicited the key fact (duvet bulging into the seal), but then inexplicably declared the cause unconfirmed and sent the homeowner to an engineer, failing to connect the obvious overload to the dE door error and leaving them without a fix for a no-fault situation.
